# IoT Ethernet dependency

Copied from `Metalio-E-INK4-Plus-main/components/espressif__iot_eth`, version 0.1.0.
Original Espressif license is in `license.txt`; source file notices are retained.
Included only by the S31 system firmware component list. The NT26 driver uses
this version's `user_data` API; upgrading requires reviewing netif integration.
